Subject: Project update: revised delivery date of 14 April

We want to give you a clear update on the project timeline. The third-party integration required for this phase needed additional certification steps that took longer to complete than the vendor originally indicated, and that certification had to be finished before we could safely move into the next stage of build and testing.

As a result, the delivery date is now set for 14 April, two weeks later than originally planned. This gives our team the time needed to complete integration testing properly once certification is confirmed, so that the handover meets the quality standards we committed to at the outset.

Does 14 April still work well with your own scheduling on your end, or are there any downstream deadlines we should factor into how we sequence the remaining work?
